test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 16 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A 360 m train crosses an electric pole in 12 seconds. Find the time (in seconds) taken by the train to cross a 150 m long bridge.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Since the speed of the **Train** is constant, **Time** is directly proportional to **Distance**.

Case 1: Crosses pole → Distance = 360 m → Time = 12 sec

Case 2: Crosses bridge → Distance = 360 + 150 = 510 m

Required Time = (12 ÷ 360) × 510 = 17 sec

**∴ The correct answer is 17 sec.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Length of **Train** = 360 m, **Time** to cross pole = 12 sec, Length of **Bridge** = 150 m.

**Formula Used:** Speed = Distance ÷ Time

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ba05fee4f09b6f4f68f2a27119a19d1c0aaf7c5b9fe8f68dba2dd4f4a2b25111.png] 

⇒ Speed of **Train** = Length of Train ÷ Time to cross pole

⇒ Speed = 360 ÷ 12 = 30 m/s

⇒ Total distance to cross **Bridge** = Length of Train + Length of Bridge

⇒ Total Distance = 360 + 150 = 510 m

⇒ Time taken = Total Distance ÷ Speed

⇒ Time taken = 510 ÷ 30 = 17 sec

**∴ The correct answer is 17 sec.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed

When two objects move in the same direction, relative speed = |v₁ − v₂|. In opposite directions, relative speed = v₁ + v₂.

Unit Conversion

To convert km/hr to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert m/s to km/hr, multiply by 18/5.

Distance Logic

When a train crosses a stationary point object (pole/man), distance = length of train. When crossing a platform/bridge, distance = train length + platform/bridge length.</p
